intro.title: Help us create the {{brand}} logo
intro.lead: {{brand}} is an animated wallpaper app for Windows and Linux that barely uses any resources and pauses itself while you play or work. It still needs a logo, and we want to make it with your input.
intro.how: There are 9 short steps, about 5 minutes. You can skip any question. If you close the page, you'll pick up where you left off.
intro.name: Your name
intro.nameHint: However you'd like us to know you: your name or your Discord nickname.
intro.privacy: We store your name and your answers, nothing else: no email, no IP. Only the {{brand}} team sees them, to design the logo.
intro.edit: You already answered. You can change your answers: they replace the previous ones.

personality.title: If {{brand}} were a person…
personality.lead: Move each point toward the side that fits best. The middle means "neither".

words.title: Pick 3 words for the brand
words.lead: The ones that describe it best. You can pick fewer.

kanji: "Shin": the core, the wick of a candle.

simbolo: Recognizable without text, like an icon.
simbolo_nombre: The mark and the name together.
nombre: The name set in its own lettering.
sello: Like a hanko: a stamp with the kanji.

styles.title: Which style do you like more?
styles.lead: In each row, pick the left or the right one. These are sample drawings, not the logo.

palette.title: Which colors?
palette.lead: Pick the palette that suits it best. The first one is what the site uses today.

actual: What the site and the app use today.
hora_azul: Before dawn: ink blue and violet.
sello: Like a Japanese seal on paper.
amanecer: Deep blue with a warm light.
mono: No color: the wallpapers bring it.

small.title: Which one reads best when small?
small.lead: The logo also goes in the taskbar and the system tray, where it is 16 pixels wide. Look at the three samples at their real size.
small.taskbar: How they look in a taskbar

free.title: To finish
free.avoid: Anything the logo should NOT have?
free.avoidHint: Colors, shapes, styles or ideas you don't like.
free.comment: Anything else you'd like to tell us?

done.title: Thank you, {{name}}!
done.text: Your answers arrived. We'll use them to put together several logo proposals, and then we'll vote on them on this same page.

errors.invalid_name: Write a name of 2 to 60 characters.
errors.invalid_answers: Some answer isn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many submissions from your connection. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find your previous answer. Send it as a new one.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't send. Try again in a moment.
